problem: Different straight lines parallel to the same proper line are parallel to each other.

proof_idea.original: Use corresponding/alternate angle equalities from I.29, then I.27.
proof_idea.analytic: A nonzero common direction and the planar Gram identity give zero determinant between target directions. If their separation vanished, actual line sets would coincide, contradicting the target-line distinctness condition.
